title: Prove two moved corrections do not emit in short G20 conjugations (no κ)
body:
## Result and claim type

**Scoped negative result (finite certificate). No κ change, no selected-frontier update.** The selected record stays κ = 781451/250000000 (PR #6030), with its five framework assumptions.

On the emitted local word of PR #5708, move **two** corrections of any A2 conjugation with 2, 3 or 4 contacts onto other frames of the published one-edge route table, keeping the remaining corrections on their contact frames. All 723,788,875 such assignments fail to emit. None changes the paid histogram, so none lowers the paid-query moment on (0, 1).

This answers open question 1 of unpaidmoon's PR #6633 (head `2ca0030166f85a833da2a3eb66a0bf82ac3dfe1c`), which also appears in PR #6337's package.

| Contacts | Intervals | Correction pairs | Assignments | Emitted |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 331 | 331 | 133,467,475 | 0 |
| 3 | 250 | 750 | 302,418,750 | 0 |
| 4 | 119 | 714 | 287,902,650 | 0 |

The emitter stops at the first missing route. Every assignment falls into exactly one class: rejected in the shared prefix (80,241,775), at the first moved meeting (607,824,540), between the moves (35,467,290), at the second moved meeting (255,171), or in the tail after a full replay (99). The verifier asserts that these classes partition the assignments. It caches the state after each shared prefix, so the full census runs in about 15 s.

Controls:
- 125 sampled assignments, 25 per class, are rebuilt and emitted from scratch. All of them reject.
- The same emitter reproduces PR #6337's one-move census at 1..3 contacts: 28,149 meeting hosts and 26 emissions with shapes `H4` and `5 H2 − 2 H4`.

## Evidence and reproduction

CPython 3.12, standard library only, from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B research/g20-two-moved-corrections/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B research/g20-two-moved-corrections/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-two-moved-corrections
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/g20-two-moved-corrections --check-source-history
```

Observed locally: both direct runs print `PASS_G20_TWO_MOVED_CORRECTIONS intervals=331/250/119 pairs=1795 assignments=723788875 prefix_fail=80241775 first_meet=607824540 middle_fail=35467290 second_meet=255171 full_replays=99 tail_missing=99 emitted=0 savings=0 sampled_controls=125 one_move_control=28149/26 no_new_kappa=true` (13.4 s and 17.1 s). The registered runner printed `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and the commit check printed `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at `216df71f0cd7a8d5ba34aa832f298b063c85242c`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

- Exactly two moved corrections. Three or more moves are not enumerated.
- Intervals with 2 to 4 contacts. Moved frames at five or more contacts are not enumerated.
- Published route table only. A missing edge is a rejection on this table. It does not prove that no other native path exists.
- Not run: the #5708 integration replay, the 18-call caller, adjoint columns, moduli 101 and 10201, ordinary admission, Lean, Docker, `make frontier6030-verify`.

## Open next questions

1. Can three or more moved corrections in one 3- or 4-contact interval emit and save? Only 99 two-move words reach a full replay, and each misses a later route.
2. Can one or two moved corrections at five or more contacts lower the paid moment? PR #6305 covers those lengths only at the contact frame.
3. Does one added route make a two-move word emit with a saving? Group the second-meeting failures by their first missing frame pair.

## Related open work

- #6633 (unpaidmoon): one moved correction at 4 contacts on the same word. This package answers its open question 1. My one-move control covers only 1..3 contacts, so it does not compute #6633's numbers.
- #6656 (petalas) and #6641 (unpaidmoon): the G20 boundary ADD floor. Different quantity, no shared number.

## Credit

Word, route table, constructor and A2 relation: Ali Romman's `research/g20-conjugation-admission` (PR #5708) and the G20 lineage named there. Moved-correction model, meeting test and one-move censuses: unpaidmoon's PR #6337 and PR #6633. Contact-frame census at four or more contacts: PR #6305. The two-move census and its verifier were produced by Nick Petalas.

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM were checked; none studies G20 conjugations or moved corrections, so Related open work is unchanged.
